home.description: When polarization divides society into groups that begin to see each other as morally incompatible, coexistence and mobility between these groups diminish. Over time, rigid social barriers emerge, forming informal "castes" that deepen inequality and segregation. Social media with bubble algorithms accelerates this process, making democratic coexistence unviable.

politicalFanatic.title: The Political Fanatic
content: The worst fanatic is the political fanatic.
He doesn't read, doesn't watch, and isn't interested in anything outside his partisan bubble.
He doesn't hesitate to share fake news, offensive content, and threats to attack his enemies and promote chaos in society, because he ignores how democracies die.
The political fanatic is so hideous that he prides himself on using violence on any occasion to silence opponents.

The imbecil doesn't know that from his hate militancy fascism is born, the oppressive dictatorship and the worst of all autocrats, which is the genocidal, inhumane, demagogic tyrant and pawn of neoliberal and reactionary politicians.
politicalFanatic.adaptation: — Adaptation of the text "The Political Illiterate", by Bertolt Brecht.

about.title: Welcome to Castas.top!
about.intro: The purpose of this site is to offer a diagnostic tool for one of the most challenging phenomena in modern democracies: affective polarization. More than a simple divergence of opinions, this process occurs when politics ceases to be a debate of ideas and becomes a matter of identity and emotional aversion.
about.body: As political differences intensify, emotional, moral, and social rejection between groups also grows, weakening trust and coexistence. This process can lead to the fragmentation of society into isolated blocks, similar to castes, in which dialogue is reduced and the legitimacy of the other is denied.
about.closing: In a scenario of growing social distancing and ideological tensions, discussing affective polarization is fundamental to identify how emotions — and not just ideas — influence our judgments, being the first step to promote healthier dialogue and reduce hostility between different groups in society.
about.howItWorksIntro: The site's operation is quite simple and intuitive. When opening the main page, you can start the test immediately, without needing to log in or perform any other configuration. To answer the questions, you must select the option that best represents your personal values and life choices. Answer honestly!
about.dimensionsIntro: Affective polarization can be measured in 5 dimensions, each measurable through 8 questions:

dimensions.a: measures irritation and negative visceral reaction when hearing the opposing group;
dimensions.b: evaluates the tendency to see the other as ignorant, malicious, or dishonest;
dimensions.c: verifies the discomfort in living or establishing personal bonds (such as friendship or family) with those who think differently;
dimensions.d: analyzes the perception of the other group as an existential threat or someone who should have fewer political rights;
dimensions.e: observes how much a person lives in a "bubble" of media consumption and exclusive social circles of their own group.

about.resultExample: At the end of the test, your result will be presented, with scores in each of the dimensions. If you want, you can share the result on your social networks.

about.title: About the Affective Polarization Test
about.content: Our test consists of 40 questions that evaluate 5 specific dimensions of affective polarization (8 questions for each dimension). The objective is strictly informative and entertainment.

data.title: Data and local storage
items: The app works offline and does not collect identifying data or use ads or trackers.
Personal Data: No personal information (such as name, email, or ID) is required to take the test.
Local storage: Only your completed result and language preference are saved on your Android device so you can view the result later.
Answers are used in memory to calculate the result. The app saves no individual answers and does not send results to a server.

sharing.title: Sharing Results
sharing.content: When you tap Share, the app copies the result to the Android clipboard. Pasting it in another app is subject to that app’s privacy policy.

clearData.title: How to Clear Your Data
clearData.content: You can clear Castas data in Android settings. If you copied or shared a result, remove that copy separately.

spam.content: The app does not request contacts or send emails, messages or notifications.
